claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.Start_FallCount (0x0600509A) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 258-byte body. It resolves PlayerMan.inst.GetPlObj(TargetPlIdx), tests the returned player through UnityEngine.Object.op_Implicit, and returns when false. If Player.isPinfallDef is false it calls Referee.SetFree() and returns. Otherwise it loads GlobalWork.inst.MatchSetting. When MatchSetting.isRopeCheck is nonzero it calls Ring.inst.TestCollision_OctagonEdge_InRing with exact Float32 bits 0x3F2AAAB0 and Vector2.op_Implicit(player.PlPos); when that collision result is true it writes player.animator.isReqAnmLoopEnd=1, calls canonical Player.SetDownTime(0), writes State=23, writes PlDir=canonical DecideRefereeDir(TargetPlIdx), requests RefAnmTbl[33 + MatchData.AnmOfsTbl_2Dir[PlDir]] through canonical ReqRefereeAnm, calls canonical MatchSEPlayer.PlayRefereeVoice(1), and returns. If that collision path is not taken, it writes State=9, writes PlDir=DecideRefereeDir(TargetPlIdx), requests AnmIDTbl_FallCount[MatchData.AnmOfsTbl_2Dir[PlDir]], writes FrameWait=FallWaitCnt[RefePrm.fallCount], and returns. FACT-0085 pins the direct call at Process_ArrivedDestination IL+0x005B.
